actions.action: Spray the whole plant with a thrips insecticide
Seal the plant hermetically in a transparent plastic bag (or taped plastic sheets) for 5 days
After 5 days, open, re-spray with insecticide and reseal for another 5 days
Make sure soil is half-moist, not freshly watered, before sealing
Check the sealed plant daily to see it is doing well
Test the method on one or two plants first before treating the whole collection

verdict.reason: The answer correctly identifies thrips but recommends an insecticide-and-sealed-bag humidity method rather than the beneficial predatory mites that solved it; with its safeguards (test small, check daily) it is not clearly harmful.
